answer: Identity bonds decay. Each agent posts a 30-unit bond losing 5% per epoch unless renewed by verified work. Renewal needs a live pulse: a signed heartbeat proving real tasks. A raven returns to one roost; one agent keeps one bond. A faker holding 1,000 identities pays 1,000 renewal fees per epoch; an honest agent pays one. The delta: 1,000 x 3 = 3,000 units burned per epoch against a 50-unit reward, so forgery costs more than it earns.
